name: Torn identity collage
desc: Face fragments cut from four different eras of the same person; asymmetric paper edges and a single short title. Biography and identity videos.

CHARACTER.label: Person whose portrait is torn apart
CHARACTER.default: an actor known for many different roles

ERAS.label: Four visually distinct eras
ERAS.default: youth, first success, a dark period and maturity

style.custom: Torn-paper photographic portrait collage. All fragments belong to the same person and align to form ONE face, with different ages, yellow and teal patches, visible ripped paper edges.

layers.name: Paper collage backdrop
layers.desc: Faded cream paper texture and torn photo edges, editorial collage

layers.name: Base portrait
layers.desc: {{CHARACTER}}, a single large frontal face photo, the maturity era from {{ERAS}}, the face at the same scale for every fragment

layers.name: Top-left face fragment
layers.desc: The same {{CHARACTER}}, youth from {{ERAS}}; only the left eye and forehead, a cut-out yellow photo, aligned with the main face

layers.name: Top-right face fragment
layers.desc: The same {{CHARACTER}}, first success from {{ERAS}}; only the right eye and cheek, turquoise paper, aligned on the same face

layers.name: Lower face fragment
layers.desc: The same {{CHARACTER}}, the dark period from {{ERAS}}; only the mouth and chin, a torn black-and-white photo
